title: Slow-Cooker Teriyaki Ribs
description: This baby back ribs slow cooker recipe couldn’t be easier — ribs go in the slow cooker with teriyaki sauce. Once cooked through, they are glazed with a simple balsamic glaze.
ingredients: 2.5 pounds baby back ribs, cut into 2-rib portions

steps.text: Sprinkle baby back ribs with pepper and place in a slow cooker. Pour 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce on top. Cover and cook until tender, 4 hours on High or 7 hours on Low.
Cut ribs apart. Combine remaining 1/3 cup teriyaki sauce, balsamic vinegar, and garlic in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes. Brush sauce over ribs.

video.description: In this video, learn to make slow cooker teriyaki ribs, the perfect indoor alternative when weather prevents you from using an outdoor smoker. The slow cooker will produce ribs so fall-off-the-bone tender that you may even start to prefer it over a smoker. The tangy sauce that covers these ribs could not be easier to make, since it only has three ingredients. Serve the ribs with coleslaw for a quick and easy meal.
